message.text:
RebuildMemoPayload stores Tags and Property in the payload, but Mentions are extracted without being stored.

Checking memo_mention_helpers.go to confirm whether mentions are separate from payload metadata. Also investigating whether RunOnce is triggered during server startup or used as a standalone migration tool.

`memopayload.RunOnce` computes the metadata but is not wired into server startup. `CreateMemo` always triggers `RebuildMemoPayload`. `UpdateMemo` only triggers it when the update mask includes the "content" path.

`RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` from `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. It stores `Tags` and `Property` in the payload. Mentions are extracted too but are not stored in the payload; they are used separately for notifications.

Tags are extracted from the content while excluding tags inside links and images. The property field contains five flags: `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` drawn from the first H1 heading. Location is user-set, not derived. Snippet generation is handled separately in the converter.

message.text:
CreateMemo and UpdateMemo with content trigger rebuilds.

memopayload.RunOnce in runner.go is a manual batch rebuild utility. It is not wired to server startup. CreateMemoComment routes through CreateMemo and therefore triggers rebuilds.
Searching for `CreateMemoComment` to locate where memo metadata is computed.

CreateMemoComment likely triggers RebuildMemoPayload through CreateMemo. The full picture is now clear.

The computation site is `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. That function performs a single goldmark AST walk and also exposes `ExtractProperties` as a standalone helper.

Triggers are threefold:
- `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (line 108) always recomputes.
- `UpdateMemo` in the same file (line 447) recomputes only when the update mask path is `"content"`.
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` triggers a batch rebuild of all memos. This utility is not wired to server startup.

The extracted properties live in `MemoPayload` per `proto/store/memo.proto`.

Tags are deduplicated `#tag` tokens from markdown, excluding tags inside links or images.

Property flags indicate presence of links, task lists, code blocks, incomplete tasks, and plain text from the first H1 heading.

Mentions are extracted too, but `RebuildMemoPayload` only persists Tags and Property. Mentions are used ephemerally for notifications.

A preview snippet is generated on-the-fly during API conversion in `memo_service_webhooks.go` via `GenerateSnippet`. It is not persisted in `MemoPayload` and is not rebuilt by the same pipeline.
